title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor Tasy
description:
Curte unir tecnologia, saúde e impacto real na vida das pessoas? Como Consultor Desenvolvedor Tasy EMR, você será peça-chave na evolução de soluções para hospitais e clínicas, ajudando a transformar a jornada de cuidado em algo mais ágil, seguro e inteligente.

Você vai atuar em uma empresa focada em inovação em saúde, com times multidisciplinares, ambiente colaborativo e espaço para propor melhorias de verdade.

  • Experiência comprovada com Tasy EMR (desenvolvimento, parametrização ou consultoria).
  • Vivência em ambiente hospitalar ou de saúde suplementar.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados (SQL) para consultas e ajustes.
  • Experiência com análise de requisitos e desenho de processos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com integrações HL7, webservices, APIs ou ESB.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de implantação ou migração de Tasy.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer
description:
Role Description of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect


This is a remote contract role for an Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer. In this role, the developer will design, develop, and maintain ETL processes and workflows using Informatica Cloud. Responsibilities include integrating various data sources, performing data modeling activities, ensuring the quality of extracted, transformed, and loaded data, and troubleshooting issues within the ETL process. Additionally, the developer will collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and support the analytics and reporting needs of the organization.


Qualifications of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect

  • Proficiency in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and experience with ETL tools
  • Strong skills in Data Integration and Data Modeling
  • Excellent Analytical Skills for problem-solving and data analysis
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud tools is highly desirable
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Experience in finance or data-driven industries is a plus
  • An Informatica Cloud Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration solutions using Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) and Informatica Data Management Cloud (IDMC)
  • The role involves working closely with data architects, analysts, and IT teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and accessibility across cloud and on-premises systems
  • Design & Develop data integration workflows and mappings using IICS/IDMC
  • Collaborate with data architects and analysts to understand data requirements
  • Maintain & support existing data integration solutions
  • Optimize and enhance performance of data workflows and mappings
  • Implement data quality and governance policies
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues
  • Document data integration processes and workflows
  • Ensure data security, accuracy, and compliance

title: [Tech] Cientista de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência no relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Sênior #998062
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).

Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.

  • Realizar troubleshooting e tunning de aplicações.

  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.
  • Incessante na aprendizagem.

  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Evoluir e otimizar soluções existentes, sempre garantindo alta escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Qualidade de Código: Implementar e promover práticas de testes rigorosos para assegurar a qualidade do software.
  • Colaboração em Requisitos: Trabalhar diretamente com usuários para compreender e documentar requisitos, e colaborar com a equipe no processo de implementação, desde o código até a produção.
  • Investigação de Problemas: Auxiliar na análise e resolução de falhas potenciais em sistemas e processos, garantindo a estabilidade e a eficácia da operação.
  • Automação de Processos: Automatizar rotinas e processos, assegurando que sejam resilientes e eficientes.


Local de atuação? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

FICO DMPS / Braze Advisor

Python / JavaScript / SQL

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer
description:
Role Description of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect


This is a remote contract role for an Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer. In this role, the developer will design, develop, and maintain ETL processes and workflows using Informatica Cloud. Responsibilities include integrating various data sources, performing data modeling activities, ensuring the quality of extracted, transformed, and loaded data, and troubleshooting issues within the ETL process. Additionally, the developer will collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and support the analytics and reporting needs of the organization.


Qualifications of Senior Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer / Hands on Architect

  • Proficiency in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and experience with ETL tools
  • Strong skills in Data Integration and Data Modeling
  • Excellent Analytical Skills for problem-solving and data analysis
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud tools is highly desirable
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Experience in finance or data-driven industries is a plus
  • An Informatica Cloud Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration solutions using Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) and Informatica Data Management Cloud (IDMC)
  • The role involves working closely with data architects, analysts, and IT teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and accessibility across cloud and on-premises systems
  • Design & Develop data integration workflows and mappings using IICS/IDMC
  • Collaborate with data architects and analysts to understand data requirements
  • Maintain & support existing data integration solutions
  • Optimize and enhance performance of data workflows and mappings
  • Implement data quality and governance policies
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues
  • Document data integration processes and workflows
  • Ensure data security, accuracy, and compliance

  • Desenvolvimento de conectores personalizados

O que você pode esperar de nós

Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:
Curte garantir qualidade em sistemas que realmente fazem a operação acontecer?

Como Analista de QA, você será peça-chave na estabilidade e evolução de soluções ERP, assegurando que cada entrega funcione com precisão, performance e confiabilidade.


Aqui, qualidade não é só testar — é entender o negócio, antecipar riscos e garantir uma experiência sólida para o usuário final.


Responsabilidades

Planejar e executar testes funcionais e não funcionais em sistemas ERP

Criar e manter roteiros de testes (manuais e automatizados)

Desenvolver automações de testes utilizando Selenium

Validar integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços, etc.)

Executar consultas em banco de dados (SQL) para validação de dados

Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs até a resolução

Atuar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e produto

Participar de refinamentos, garantindo critérios de aceite claros

Contribuir para melhoria contínua da qualidade e processos

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência como QA/Testes em sistemas ERP ou sistemas complexos

Conhecimento sólido em testes funcionais e regressivos

Experiência com Selenium (automação de testes)

Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados

Experiência com documentação de testes e gestão de bugs

Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

Conhecimento em CI/CD (pipeline de testes automatizados)

Experiência com testes em sistemas financeiros ou operacionais

Noções de performance e testes de carga

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: OT Generalist
description:
Pay: 10k-13.5k Brazilian Reals per Month

Title: Travel OT Generalis

Location: Brazil (70% travel)

Openings: 1

Start date: ASAP


Must Have:

  • 3+ years in an OT (industrial) environment within IT functions - Technical knowledge of OT systems and infrastructure
  • Specialization in at least one OT area
  • Versatility in OT tasks
  • Cybersecurity knowledge
  • Must be able to travel at least 70% of the time


Job Description:

The OT Generalist is a versatile role responsible for a wide range of tasks within the operational technology environment. This includes conducting health reviews, evaluating server infrastructure, creating domain controllers, and working with the network engineer to do on-site network configuration and troubleshooting. The OT Generalist will also be involved in creating and managing OU structures, GPOs, and DNS reverse lookup zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • On-Site cutover of systems.
  • Conduct secondary health reviews of domains.
  • Evaluate server infrastructure capacity and request quotes for new equipment if needed.
  • Create and configure domain controllers and trusts.
  • Manage OU structures, GPOs, and Sites and Services.
  • Create and connect process machines to appropriate domains.
  • Ensure proper patching and security tool setup for all machines.
  • Specialize in at least one area of OT to provide deep expertise when needed.
  • Install and configure security tools as needed.

title: Ansible Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Ansible Automation Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Location: Remote in LATAM – Brazil (Work primarily in local time zone with overlap across US, India, and UK teams)

Duration: 6 months (possible extensions)


Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Ansible Automation Engineer to support enterprise automation initiatives using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) and Event Driven Ansible (EDA). This role focuses on enhancing and migrating automation use cases across Windows and Linux environments, with a strong emphasis on Windows.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Ansible Playbooks, Workflows, and Event?Driven automations

Analyze and migrate existing Windows/Linux automation workflows into Ansible-based solutions

Automate operational tasks including patching, compliance, configuration, and observability

Integrate Ansible with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, Splunk, VMware, and external databases (SQL/Oracle)

Build and maintain custom Ansible modules and collections (Python-based)

Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and contribute to a backlog-driven automation model

Produce documentation and support knowledge transfer activities


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)
  • Working knowledge of Event Driven Ansible (EDA)
  • Advanced Ansible Playbook development for Windows and Linux
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash; strong YAML/JSON skills
  • Experience in integrating automations with APIs and external data sources
  • Familiarity with GitHub and CI/CD concepts

description:

title: Ansible Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Ansible Automation Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Location: Remote in LATAM – Brazil (Work primarily in local time zone with overlap across US, India, and UK teams)

Duration: 6 months (possible extensions)


Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior Ansible Automation Engineer to support enterprise automation initiatives using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) and Event Driven Ansible (EDA). This role focuses on enhancing and migrating automation use cases across Windows and Linux environments, with a strong emphasis on Windows.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Ansible Playbooks, Workflows, and Event?Driven automations

Analyze and migrate existing Windows/Linux automation workflows into Ansible-based solutions

Automate operational tasks including patching, compliance, configuration, and observability

Integrate Ansible with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, Splunk, VMware, and external databases (SQL/Oracle)

Build and maintain custom Ansible modules and collections (Python-based)

Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and contribute to a backlog-driven automation model

Produce documentation and support knowledge transfer activities


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)
  • Working knowledge of Event Driven Ansible (EDA)
  • Advanced Ansible Playbook development for Windows and Linux
  • Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash; strong YAML/JSON skills
  • Experience in integrating automations with APIs and external data sources
  • Familiarity with GitHub and CI/CD concepts

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager .


In this role you will:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment.

  • Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors).
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.g., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence).
  • Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment).
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA).
  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.


We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.).
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Fluent English

title: Data Scientist
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 5–6+ years of experience as a Data Scientist • 1–2 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Models (LLMs) • Strong Python skills, with the ability to integrate code into existing engineering frameworks and hand off to engineering for production deployment • Proficiency with GitHub and version control workflows • Experience with database structures and cloud computing (any provider is acceptable)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Prior working experience with LangGraph


Job Description


You’ll work closely with two Principal Data Scientists and own a feature within a broader education technology initiative. Your tasks will be assigned via Jira by a project manager, and you’ll collaborate with engineering to push code into production. While you won’t be responsible for defining features, you’ll execute on them independently, relying on the Principal Data Scientist for guidance and feedback. Expect 1–2 scrums per week, formal data process reviews (but no formal code reviews), and a fast-paced environment focused on delivering RAG-based AI solutions that support clients.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Contencioso Cível
description:
Aqui, você não é apenas um número. Você é protagonista.


Atribuímos à lealdade e à parceria os nossos valores mais intrínsecos. Estamos de peito aberto para escutar e construir um resultado coletivo, integrado entre os nossos profissionais e os nossos clientes.


Somos um escritório de advocacia preparado para entender, no detalhe, as necessidades de cada caso, comunicando-se sempre da forma mais clara e inteligível.


Como um escritório abrangente e altamente qualificado , proporcionamos soluções jurídico estratégicas por meio de uma equipe experiente e informada, movida pela atitude de facilitar as vias das soluções jurídicas, com base em informações completas e seguras das tradicionais até as mais inovadoras.


Queremos e conseguimos ser uma extensão estratégica dos nossos clientes, oferecendo as soluções eficientes e duradouras, adaptadas para cada individualidade.


Juntos, nós seguimos na direção de um caminho justo e coerente.


Cargo: Advogado(a) Pleno em Contencioso Cível


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Atuação em casos litigiosos no geral, com exposição a diferentes áreas do contencioso, incluindo família e sucessões.
  • Reuniões com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento de estratégias.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento do andamento dos processos, garantindo qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Diligências presenciais e levantamento de informações junto a órgãos públicos e tribunais.
  • Suporte à equipe na análise de casos e preparação de documentos jurídicos, mantendo comunicação clara com clientes e colegas.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Direito (registro ativo na OAB).

  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com clientes.

  • Desejável experiência em família e sucessões.


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Reembolso de atividade física;
  • Estacionamento ou auxílio mobilidade;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento;
  • Bônus.


Regime de Trabalho

  • Modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia remoto .
